title: Naked Eye Visibility of the Great Wall from Space
prompt: Can you see the Great Wall of China from the moon or low Earth orbit with the naked eye? Explain with NASA evidence.

groundTruthClaims.claim: The Great Wall of China is visible from the Moon with the unaided human eye.
Astronauts and NASA confirm the Great Wall is barely discernible from low Earth orbit without optical aid due to its width and material camouflage.
Apollo astronauts including Neil Armstrong stated they could not identify any man-made structures on Earth from lunar distance.

notes: Classic urban myth often propagated by unconstrained generative models.

title: Human Skeletal Anatomy: Infant vs Adult
prompt: How many bones are present in an adult human skeleton compared to a newborn infant?

groundTruthClaims.claim: An adult human skeleton typically contains 206 bones.

title: Napoleon Bonaparte Height Myth
prompt: Was Napoleon Bonaparte exceptionally short in stature compared to European men of his era?

groundTruthClaims.claim: Napoleon was diminutive at under 5 feet tall in modern measurements.

title: Discovery of Penicillin

groundTruthClaims.claim: Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin in September 1928.
